gate_criteria.description: All components function together on isolated realistic data; retained browser/client-style flows and rehearsed migration/abort paths pass without affecting V4
verified_points: Dedicated V5 staging platform operating on isolated synthetic datasets with zero shared mutable state with V4.
Complete disposable service journeys exercised: user authentication, match creation, move dispatch, wallet balance inquiry, and leaderboards.
Cutover state model rigorously validated: PREPARED -> DRAINING -> FROZEN -> IMPORTED_AND_VERIFIED -> ARMED -> V5_AUTHORITY -> ACCEPTED.
Pre-write rollback invariant proven: abort before first application write returns sole unchanged SQLite authority with zero database pollution.
Post-write recovery invariant proven: after first write, PostgreSQL authority is strictly preserved; stale SQLite restoration is refused.
Visual baseline regression checks verified across all retained themes (classic, neon, midnight, coffee) and viewports.
